title: a durable(...) call given a second argument is rejected at the call
notes: specification/durable-execution.mdx, 'Compiler-Recognized API': the argument MUST be an inline function or a statically resolvable function — one argument, one Flow. COVERAGE.md 20.5 records this sibling branch of VIBE4103 — wrong argument count, reported at the CALL rather than at the argument — as the unwritten half of an-opaque-durable-argument-is-rejected, which pins the other branch. A policy-bag second argument is also the most likely accidental spelling for an author arriving from other durable frameworks, so the refusal must not silently ignore the extra argument.
